goal: Build the smallest deterministic, restart-safe local controller that executes one explicitly authorized Career OS engineering milestone through state verification, one bounded Claude Code builder loop, deterministic testing and repair, independent read-only Cursor review and bounded correction, full Assurance Baseline verification, and generation of a durable review package before stopping for Bora's explicit human approval. The controller must make repository/run-state continuity independent of ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor conversation lifetime and must never redefine milestone authority.
acceptance_conditions: Controller preflight fetches/verifies origin/main and fails closed on incompatible baseline or repository state.
A run receives a durable unique run_id and atomically persisted manifest/state transitions under a gitignored local run-state directory.
A stopped/interrupted run can be resumed without relying on ChatGPT, Claude Code, or Cursor conversation history.
Resume always re-verifies Git state, origin/main, contract integrity, branch/worktree identity, changed-path authority, and unauthorized mutation before continuing.
Exactly one controller may own a governed branch/worktree at a time; stale-lock recovery is explicit and fail-closed.
Retry budgets are finite and come from a separately versioned execution policy snapshotted into the run rather than redefining milestone semantic authorization.
Claude Code is invoked only as the bounded builder and cannot mark the milestone successful, commit, push, merge, or modify contract/control files unless explicitly authorized.
Deterministic tests decide mechanical test success and all successful test evidence is invalidated by later working-tree mutation.
Cursor is invoked independently in a read-only review boundary using contract, baseline, actual diff, rules, and test evidence without Claude's persuasive implementation narrative.
Required reviewer findings cannot be silently dismissed by an LLM; ambiguous or disputed findings surface HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Full canonical Assurance Baseline must pass after the final reviewed diff before READY_FOR_HUMAN_APPROVAL.
V1 stops at READY_FOR_HUMAN_APPROVAL and performs no commit, push, pull-request creation, merge, or autonomous Blueprint/doctrine modification.
Runtime artifacts contain no credentials, secrets, chain-of-thought, or required dependence on raw model transcripts.
python scripts/verify_milestone_state.py passes for the governed branch.
python scripts/verify_assurance_baseline.py reports ALL PHASES PASSED.
stop_conditions: origin/main or repository reality is incompatible with the authorized baseline or current run state
contract snapshot/hash differs from the authorized governing contract
implementation requires any path outside allowed_paths or any forbidden/protected surface
implementation would require modifying BLUEPRINT.md, AGENTS.md, existing state/milestone judge machinery, Truth-layer schemas, qualification/decision runtime, or Golden Test expectations
implementation requires changing canonical builder/reviewer roles or introducing Codex as a V1 dependency
implementation requires commit, push, PR creation, merge, or other remote repository mutation
implementation or review retry budget is exhausted
reviewer finding is materially disputed or semantically ambiguous and cannot be resolved deterministically
implementation requires a new third-party runtime dependency or credential architecture not already authorized
a safe restart/resume state cannot be reconstructed from Git plus persisted run artifacts
